_doc: Step 50 pacing targets, FROZEN before any tuning (design/INCREMENTAL_PACING.md explains each). Times are seconds of active play from the first look (a blind session's clock; the simulator's active time). kind exact: relative_error = |observed - target| / target, must be <= tolerance; max / min: pass-fail bounds. primary targets gate the issue: for blind evidence each is the median of three independent runs (a run that never reaches it counts as never -- a failure, not a missing sample), and the weighted aggregate of the primary exact targets must also be <= tolerance. sources: which evidence measures it (sim: tools/balance_optimizer/optimize.gd with the 'blind' profile unless `profile` says otherwise; blind: tools/blind_playtest). Metrics: journey:<key> = when the game's own journey first marked <key>; income_at:<s> = production money (sales and releases) by then; meaningful_at:<s> = level-ups + buildings + land bought + Momo hired + research levels + letters by then; first_reward_after_tap = seconds from the first tap to the first reward (money or EXP); income_gap = longest wait between two production incomes after the first Momo income, up to 10:00; momo_share_at:<s> = share of finished work stages done by Momo; prestige_ready = first moment the island can be sold for a point; tier_wall_h:<n> = wall-clock hours to reach tier n in the 48-hour calendar.

targets.why: <=15 s: the first income-producing action is done and its money shown
0-5 s: the obvious first action answers with a reward at once
<=60-90 s: a Momo works by itself and earns visible money
no more than 30 s without income once automation runs
a meaningful new thing every ~40 s in the first 10 minutes
automation is the main engine by 10 minutes, not a penalty
a Special in the 10-30 minute stretch
the nation is not a first-day thing (48-hour calendar, a player who sells at 8 points)
but it is reachable within the ~48 h free-play aspiration
